apps.name: Memory Garden
apps.subtitle: Memory training with Mochi the raccoon
apps.localizedDescription: Five cozy minutes a day: memory games, personal flashcards (FSRS), reminders that keep nudging, and a den that grows as you practise. General wellness only — not a medical device.

privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Add a photo to a memory card (e.g. a relative's face). Photos stay on this phone.
privacy.NSAlarmKitUsageDescription: Memory Garden uses alarms only for reminders you set yourself, so they can ring even when your phone is on silent.
